description:
Every popular home fix, checked before you pay for the service call. 

We price the cheap fix against what a plumber, appliance tech, or handyman actually charges, test it against real sources — building science, extension services, and the pros' own advice — and tell you honestly when the $2 fix wins and when it fails. 

Plumbing, drains, appliances, mold, water heaters, and the repair bills nobody warns you about. 

No secrets, no scare stories, every claim sourced in the description. 

📘 THE INSPECTOR'S CHECKBOOK — every kitchen, bathroom, laundry and utility check in this series, room by room, with the price of the part and the price of the call: https://oldwaysrestored.gumroad.com/l/inspectors-checkbook

New videos every week.
